about: Equinix, Inc. has its digital infrastructure, data center footprint and interconnected ecosystems empower innovations that enhance work, life and planet. The firm connects economies, countries, organizations and communities, delivering seamless digital experiences and cutting-edge AI quickly, efficiently and everywhere. Equinix, Inc. was established on June 22, 1998 and incorporated in Delaware. Equinix, Inc. is based in Redwood City, United States.
